units.source_text: 这最后一首，似乎是那位生气的按察大纳言所咏。

en.t: This last poem seems to have been composed by that angry Azechi Dainagon.

units.source_text: 此种诗歌之中，或许有笔者误听之处。

en.t: Among poems of this kind, there may be places where the writer misheard something.

units.source_text: 总之，皆非特别优秀之作。

en.t: In any case, none of them are especially outstanding works.
